blocks.x: The engineering substrate, as deployed in current programs:

items: Data Cloud
Customer graph consolidation with consent flags carried on every attribute.
Einstein Trust Layer
Salesforce's trust controls used as designed — masking, audit and scoping turned on, not just licensed.
Flow Orchestration
Long-running business processes modeled where they run, with failure paths designed.
Agentforce Patterns Under Human Checkpoints
Salesforce agents deployed with approval gates where money or commitments move.
Cdp Identity Resolution With Audit Trails
Identities merged with the merge reasons kept — privacy teams can replay every decision.
data contracts
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
freshness SLOs
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
dbt transformation graph
Tested, documented models with lineage exposure — the transform layer your analysts can actually read.
cost-aware clustering
Workloads land on the cheapest compute that still meets the latency budget.

blocks.x: The joint pattern for Salesforce Alliance: our pod does the build, your named owners hold the gates, and the evidence is generated in systems your teams already operate.
The quarter-close package, built to be handed over rather than demonstrated:

items: Joint architecture pack
The target architecture drawn against your estate, with interfaces and owners made explicit.
Certified delivery pod
A named team with the clearances your estate requires — the same people from diagnosis to handover.
Support map
Who answers when something breaks — named roles, response expectations and the escalation path.
